## Purpose

GOV-OPS-001 marks the formal boundary between *Founding Week design* and *normal enterprise operations*.

This certification is not a calendar event. It is issued only after objective evidence confirms every entry criterion below has been met. Issuing it on a deadline without evidence is not permitted.

When this document transitions from Template to Ratified, Founding Week ends.

---

## Certification Statement

*(Complete only after all entry criteria are confirmed.)*

---

I, **Isiah Howard**, Executive Sponsor of MISSION-0001, hereby certify that:

1. **Tier 1 Constitutional Artifacts** — CONST-001, CONST-002, CONST-003, and CONST-004 have been ratified and constitute the governing constitution of the SintraPrime Enterprise.

2. **Governance Infrastructure** — The review protocol (ADR-0002) is actively enforced. Hermes operates as Mission Owner with active compliance monitoring in effect.

3. **Operational Infrastructure** — Track B production validation has been observed and confirmed. Scheduled governance communications are delivered automatically to the correct Slack channels without manual intervention.

4. **Executive Reporting** — The Executive KPI Dashboard is operational. Weekly snapshots are generated and routed automatically.

5. **Audit Baseline** — GOV-AUD-001 is established as the Founding Week Baseline Assessment. All future enterprise audits reference it as the starting point.

6. **Transition Authorization** — Effective the date below, SintraPrime Enterprise transitions from *Founding Week Design* to *Normal Enterprise Operations*. The governance framework established during Founding Week is now the operational standard.

## Post-Transition Instructions

After GOV-OPS-001 is issued:

1. Archive all Founding Week working documents to `archive/founding-week/`
2. Update MISSION-0001 status to COMPLETE
3. Run GOV-AUD-002 (first post-Founding Week audit)
4. Begin MISSION-0002 (Normal Operations) with GOV-AUD-001 as baseline
5. Publish executive summary to `#executive` — Founding Week is closed
